key.decision_why: The author asked for review after only reformatting the description and squashing commits, with no reviewer assigned, so triagers need a short note on what is still missing; nothing changed enough to need a new card.
key.action_why: The next day laurynmm kept "not ready" and asked how the PR relates to the other open PRs for #19589 (per the continuing-unfinished-work guidelines), and asked the author to restore the template's self-review checklist.
changed: Squashed the two commits (code and test) into one commit, "webhooks: Separate command and text fields in Slack payload", with the same +19/-2 in the same 2 files.
Reformatted the PR description and added a self-review checklist, and commented "Ready for review!" without answering anything specific.
still_missing: No explanation of how this PR relates to the open PR #38098, which covers the same issue and is already in maintainer review with Niloth-p, or to the many earlier attempts.
The self-review checklist is a custom one, not the checklist from Zulip's PR template.
The PR does not update the docs (outgoing-webhook-payload.md) or the Slack format link in the code, which a maintainer asked for on #38098.
There is no detail on manual end-to-end testing, and nothing on the open backwards-compatibility question about python-zulip-api.
key.reply_ask: Ask the author to explain how this PR relates to the open PR #38098 (and earlier attempts), following the guidelines on continuing unfinished work, and to replace the custom self-review checklist with the one from the PR template.

must_have.fact: Says the PR does not explain its relationship to the open PR #38098, which covers the same issue and is already in maintainer review, as the continuing-unfinished-work guidelines require.
Says the self-review checklist in the description is not the one from Zulip's PR template.
Says that since the feedback the author only squashed the two commits into one and reformatted the description; the code size and files are unchanged.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and asking for more information instead of handing the PR to a reviewer.
Notes that laurynmm closed the similar PR #38902 for these same two reasons: no explanation of its relationship to the PR in review, and a non-template checklist.
